subject: Request: extended eval + additional sandbox credits for compliance testing
messages:
From: Samantha Ong <samantha.ong@medaxis.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medaxis.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended eval + additional sandbox credits for compliance testing

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at MedAxis is excited about Redwood's latency and the KV caching behavior; it looks promising for our charting and claims workflows. We have a compliance window coming up where our auditors will run an on-prem/ingress test and we need a controlled sandbox that mirrors production for 30 days.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend our eval window by 30 days beyond the current PLG trial end (current end: 2027-09-20)?
- We will need additional sandbox credits to perform heavy ingest + long-sequence generation for the auditors. Target: ~250,000 token-equivalent credits.

This work is timeboxed and for verification only; MedAxis will not use this for production traffic. Procurement is looped for any paperwork. If you need a short SOW or any evidence of the audit schedule I can share.

Attachments: MedAxis_Tech_Specs.pdf (short tech appendix)

Appreciate any flexibility here — this extension materially affects our decision timeline.

Best,
Samantha Ong
Director, Platform Engineering
MedAxis Health
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: [Internal] Fwd: Request: extended eval + additional sandbox credits for compliance testing

Team — forwarding MedAxis's ask. Quick summary: prospect requests a 30-day eval extension (would push past PLG limits) and ~250k token sandbox credits to complete compliance testing (auditors will stress ingest/generation). Procurement is looped.

Why this matters: MedAxis is a healthcare payer with a fast pilot runway; they are explicitly sensitive to audit/retention controls and are close to an internal security review. If we can support the window and credits with controls (DPA addendum, short retention, audit logs), we stand a good chance to move to a Dedicated pilot next quarter.

Decision ask: do we have authority to grant 250k tokens + 30d extension as a one-off? If not, what conditions (legal addendum, limited retention, org signoff) do you need to approve?

I attached our sandbox usage report and the prospect's tech appendix.

Attachments: sandbox_usage_report.csv, MedAxis_Tech_Specs.pdf

Thanks,
Vanessa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [Internal] Fwd: Request: extended eval + additional sandbox credits for compliance testing

Vanessa / Jordan — thanks for the context. Legal's comfortable with a limited, auditable exception but we need to gate it with a short MSA addendum and operational controls. Requirements to approve (one-off):
- Signed MSA addendum that includes:
  - explicit cap (250,000 token-equivalent credit) and one-time grant
  - 30-day extension period with defined start/end dates
  - data handling addendum: limited DB retention (30 days), no model finetuning allowed, and mandatory audit-log retention for the audit window
  - liability cap remains the standard MSA
- We should not extend any discounted pricing or change standard cancellation terms — this is a credits grant only.
- Procurement must confirm the audit schedule in writing.

If ops can enforce retention and we get a signed addendum, legal approves the 150k credit + 30 days. For the full 250k we need business signoff (Jordan / growth budget) because it exceeds our standard PLG exception threshold.

I've attached a redline of the MSA addendum that reflects the above.

Attachments: MSA_Addendum_redline.docx

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [Internal] Fwd: Request: extended eval + additional sandbox credits for compliance testing

Appreciate the legal clarity, Laura. From a commercial standpoint I'm authorizing an exception: we will approve the full 250,000 token-equivalent credit and the 30-day extension as requested, contingent on the signed MSA addendum you prepared and operational controls in place. Rationale: healthcare payer, strategic proof point if successful, and the prospect is likely to convert to paid Dedicated given their scale.

Conditions:
- Legal's MSA addendum signed (no discounts applied; credits only)
- Ops confirms retention/audit log configuration and provides a provisioning ticket (internal SLA: 24 hours after sign)
- Procurement provides written audit schedule and point of contact
- Deal will be tracked as DEAL-8392 and use Deal Desk budget for this one-time exception

Vanessa — please send the redline and the DocuSign powerform to the customer and get procurement's written confirmation. Once signed, ops will provision the tokens and I'll mark the exception approved in the tracker.

Jordan Blake
Head of Sales, PLG Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ong <samantha.ong@medaxis.com>, procurement@medaxis.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: 30-day eval extension + 250k token sandbox credit — next steps

Hi Samantha (and procurement),

Good news — Redwood can make the requested one-time exception. Summary of the approved package: 
- 250,000 token-equivalent sandbox credit (one-time, non-recurring)
- 30-day eval extension (start date: date of signed addendum; end date: 30 days later)

Required next steps (please complete to activate):
1) Please review and sign the MSA addendum (DocuSign link below). The addendum documents the credit cap, one-time window, and data handling requirements (30-day retention, audit logging enabled; no fine-tuning).
   DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&id=DOCU-SIGN-EXAMPLE-8392
2) Procurement: please reply with the auditor schedule and primary contact for the window so we can align ops provisioning.
3) Once signed, ops will provision credits within 24 hours and confirm the sandbox endpoint/credentials.

Attachments included: MedAxis_Tech_Specs.pdf, sandbox_usage_report.csv, MSA_Addendum_redline.docx

Note: This exception is a credits grant only (no price discount or SLA change). Jordan (cc) has approved the exception under Deal Desk budget; Laura (cc) confirmed legal gating items.

If you want a one-page SOW for your internal audit team we can draft that quickly — flag me and I'll coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing this pilot.

Best,
